units.source_text: 如此難看、奇怪無比、讓人看了很不舒服的表情，誰見了都會情不自禁地想說：「這個滿臉皺紋的孩子。」

en.t: It was such an ugly, utterly strange, and unsettling expression that anyone who saw it would instinctively want to say, "What a wrinkled child."

units.source_text: 我從未見過表情這麼怪異的孩子。

en.t: I had never seen a child with such an odd expression.

units.source_text: 第二張照片上的臉，已經發生了驚人的變化。

en.t: The face in the second photograph had already undergone an astonishing change.
He was dressed as a student.

units.source_text: 雖分辨不出是高中生，還是大學生，總而言之，是一位相貌英俊的學生。

en.t: It was hard to tell whether he was a high school student or a university student, but in any case he was a handsome student.

units.source_text: 但同樣不可思議的是，從他身上一點兒也感覺不出活著的人味。

en.t: Yet what was equally uncanny was that he gave off not the slightest sense of being alive.

units.source_text: 他身著學生服，胸前的口袋裡露出白手帕，雙腿交叉坐在藤椅上，依舊面帶微笑。

en.t: He wore a student uniform, a white handkerchief showed from his breast pocket, and he sat cross-legged in a wicker chair, still smiling.
